concerns: Recon said JS-only; the 'Show more events' button calls a public JSON endpoint (/ems/eventCalendar/ajaxResults/?offset&page_size) returning the same card HTML. Phase A reads it with fetch_html (httpx, browser fallback with expect_selector body). Fallback if the endpoint fails: the 10 server-rendered cards (partial, logged). Forced-fallback run (httpx 403) gave the same 35 shells.

2 third-party rows dropped as off-topic (Global Forum on Cardiology, 16th World Probiotics conference). Filter: specialty classifier = Musculoskeletal & Trauma, or title/category/teaser matches one relevance regex (orthopaedics, trauma, MSK, spine, hand, foot/ankle, arthroplasty, fracture, bone, sports, surgery, joints, casting, plus orthogeriatric terms: falls, deconditioning, prehab, osteoporosis, frailty, rehabilitation, amputee, limb). BOA's own rows always pass. Every dropped title is logged at INFO. Counts are measured over all 33 shells (venue 25 counts venue or city; the other 8 are online/no place).

Skipped on purpose: 'BOA Annual Congress 2026 - Digital Access Only' (live congress 22-25 Sep 2026 is over, rest is a recordings product whose end date is not stated as an access deadline). The 2027 Annual Congress (not a calendar card) is read from the Future Congresses page as one extra shell with no fees yet.

Fees: the booking pages (/ems-event-booking-page.html) are behind a login, so fees are only the header .event-pricing line, a booking-widget list or a 'Course fees' block. External rows link to the organiser ('Go to event website'); that link is stored as organiser_url for the fee explorer (two-hop, checklist 5), not followed here. Members' fees behind login. BOA New Consultants Course header says £100 but prose says a £95 fee: header kept.
Coverage checklist: date ranges parsed from both ends (casting courses span weeks, FSL runs 30 Aug-10 Nov); no image fee tables or CFP seen; abstracts left to the merge step.
Digital-access/on-demand cards and 'Cancelled/Postponed' titles are skipped via skip_card().

Shared base now lives in extractors/ems_calendar.py (EmsCalendarExtractor + helpers, used by boa.py and ics.py); bsg.py imports only the _UK_PLACES map from it. ems_calendar.py must ship with the boa and ics registrations. Tests: medconf-scraper/test_ems_calendar.py (9).

Audit 2026-10-22 follow-up: Ortho Update 2027 fees are public in prose on the course page ('A discounted course fee of £200 is available only for BOA members. (£300 for non-BOA members)') and are now parsed (2 GBP tiers). The booking page itself is login-walled. The 8 rows without a description (Core Skills in Orthopaedic Surgery, Trauma and orthopaedics ST3 interview course, Falls Prevention Summit, 2 x Hip Fracture Summit, Day Case Total Hip Replacement, Deconditioning, Casting Exam only) have only a title/date/venue header on the BOA page and no teaser on the card, so the extractor returns no description; the nav-menu text the audit saw on three of them is not produced by this extractor.
